title: The layout gets a core todo kind
why: o15 sends tasks a session catches to tracked files, but the layout has no todo kind, so each repo keeps its follow-ups somewhere different (q_max: specs/todo.md, with no layout key).
note: Done, Oct 27: PR 656 landed in batch PR 663 (main 1733dac). The core kind is docs/todo.md; a legacy-repos map in lint/layout.json keeps q_max's to-dos at specs/todo.md and home and home-app's at records/ until each repo moves them. Port: yes, each repo reads the layout at its roll-out.
